svg.title: Snapshot file format: DataTree with aclCache and DataNode records, then checksums and digest
svg.desc: The article's original screenshot of parsed snapshot nodes could not be recovered; this is the author's own diagram of the snapshot file format (DataTree section) from the same series of notes, with labels translated to English.
